name: call-sheet
title: DRAFT call sheet
for_each: select id,ref as name from shoot_days order by shoot_date,ref

sections.title: Shoot day
sections.sql: select ref,production,title,shoot_date,unit,location,clock_time(start_min) as call,clock_time(end_min) as wrap,safety_contact,assessment_ref,briefing from v_schedule where id=$1

sections.title: Location and emergency plan
sections.sql: select l.address,l.emergency_plan,l.permission_until from shoot_days d join locations l on l.id=d.location_id where d.id=$1

sections.title: Scenes
sections.sql: select ref,name,eighths,duration_min,status from scenes where day_id=$1 order by order_no,ref

sections.title: Cast and crew calls
sections.note: A +1d wrap is on the next day. Review all calls before distribution.
sections.sql: select p.name,b.role,clock_time(b.start_min) as call,clock_time(b.end_min) as wrap,b.status from bookings b join people p on p.id=b.person_id where b.day_id=$1 order by b.start_min,p.name

sections.title: Outstanding safety records
sections.note: A blank section does not certify a safe shoot. The production safety adviser reviews the day.
sections.sql: select rule,issue,source from v_compliance where day_id=$1

sections.title: Cast not covered for the full day
sections.sql: select scene,person,booking_status from v_cast_gaps where day_id=$1

name: production-report
title: DRAFT daily production report
for_each: select id,ref as name from shoot_days order by shoot_date,ref

sections.title: Day
sections.sql: select ref,production,shoot_date,unit,location from v_schedule where id=$1

sections.title: Scene progress
sections.sql: select ref,name,eighths,status from scenes where day_id=$1 order by order_no,ref

sections.title: Recorded hours
sections.note: Hours are per production and date, not allocated to individual units.
sections.sql: select h.person,h.status,h.worked_minutes,h.flag from v_hours h join work_logs w on w.id=h.id join shoot_days d on d.production_id=w.production_id and d.shoot_date=w.work_date where d.id=$1 order by h.person

name: risk-register
title: DRAFT shoot risk register
for_each: select id,ref as name from shoot_days order by shoot_date,ref

sections.title: Recorded risks
sections.note: The production safety adviser completes and approves the assessment. Software checks record completeness.
sections.sql: select ref,description,controls,owner,review_due,status from risks where day_id=$1 order by ref
